newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statoil begins laying NorFra gasline.
newsitem.headline: Statoil begins laying NorFra gasline.

text.p: Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil ) said on Thursday more than 90 km of the NorFra gas trunkline, which will be the world's longest submarine pipeline, have been laid since work started on April 10.
The company's Status Weekly newsletter said bad weather forced the laybarges LB 200 and DLB 1601 to suspend pipelaying for four days and 36 hours respectively.
The two vessels are due to lay 825 km of the pipeline, which will run for 840 km from the riser platform Draupner E in the North Sea to Dunkerque in northern France.
Plans call for laying of the pipeline to be completed in October, with gas deliveries scheduled to begin on October 1 next year.
